origin.description: A single typical value, or every tied mode.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A vector, factor, or ordered factor.

origin.details: Numeric values use the median, quantile type 7. Integers and ordered factors use quantile type 1. Logical, character, and unordered factors use the mode. A tie returns every mode, in table order, with missing last.
origin.value: One value, or several when the mode is tied.
